en.hook: Navigating the Agentic AI Revolution: Strategic Insights for Data Engineers in 2026
en.body: The 2026 Gartner predictions alongside NVIDIA’s GTC announcements highlight a pivotal shift toward agentic AI and inference-centric computing. This article explores the evolving role of data engineers in building scalable, real-time, and governed data infrastructure to meet these emerging demands.
en.cta: Read the full story on the site and use GitHub as the operational proof point.
